classification: NEW completions govern only these six proposed identities. Exact accepted interfaces are included as evidence, not amended globally.
casting: Use the actual native classAccess row, acquired repertoire and class engine. All six are rank8/base21RP/minimum class15. Core-compatible Action/120ft/V,S,F is retained; Furnace explicitly selects its historical alias below. Perceive legal targets/point with line of effect; total cover blocks. Actual speech, usable gesture hand and owned class focus are required. No generic upcast. Preflight legality/affordability precedes Action, RP/material/use commitment, concentration transition and chronological Dissonance/Refrain. Counter windows follow; miss/save/counter/late failure refunds nothing and restores no old concentration. No created effect retroactively modifies its own creation price.
geometry: NEW six-spell-local geometry uses feet and the accepted horizontal grid metric extended explicitly to 3D: D=max(|dx|,|dy|,|dz|). Range uses caster position to target foot/point. Matrix membership means a positive-volume intersection of actual occupied body interior and the closed grid-metric sphere; exact mere surface contact is not membership. Center-to-body line of effect clips eligibility. No proxy/familiar origin substitutes for original casting body. This is not a global metric amendment.
clock: Selected one-minute effects last 60 elapsed seconds from successful application, explicit absolute endpoints retained through extra turns, death, reordering and initiative transitions. Expiry at equality precedes new eligibility. Concentration ends on actual loss/incapacitation/death; nonconcentration records persist after creator death unless their own target/lifecycle ends. Effects are magical spell applications with generating rank8 and ordinary dispel interfaces, not physical objects. Actual Wizard class Dispel is rank3/3RP, INT+PB vs18 for these effects; no assumed Greater Dispel acquisition.
suppression: Actual applicable suppression suspends an application, never clocks, counters, causal credit, receipt ledgers or prior outcomes. No queued RP, missed interception, retroactive waiver or delayed information. An already committed lawful payment is history. Reentry/recast requires its own current checks. Native suppression input/output and no same-cast rescan rules remain exact.
resources: RP pools and maxima stay per actual identity, separate from HP/temp/form buffers, RC, charges, components and uses. Positive RP charges require a real personal RP pool and actual funds. Credits clip at actual maximum; waste is recorded and not banked. No transaction is replayable by changing cast/application IDs; preserve original causal root, payer, receiver and actual price allocation. Cast copies retain their own exact no-copy/no-resource restrictions; rank8 payloads are outside accepted Fate Echo rank0..7 and cannot be copied by it.
replacement: For Shield/Furnace one operative same-name application per recipient; a successful new application replaces the old even with another owner, without refund or copying counters. Nullification retains one per target, successful new failure-save application replaces; success creates none and leaves prior valid record. Mastery has one per beneficiary, successful new one replaces. Matrix one concentration field per caster, overlapping fields grant one waiver total. Starting same-owner concentration replacement ends the old at commitment even if countered. Stale cleanup addresses only its exact application ID.
holds: Authored conditional actor encounters are not established campaign events. Missing real external damage/transfer/Null/form/hazard/defense/item/ancestry profiles remain whole-case or branch holds, with no synthetic source acquisition. All current inherited qualifications are retained verbatim in authority/latest_accepted and the exact source packet.
